title.narrative: Advancing MAB and Geopark Networks in the Maghreb Region

description.narrative:
This workplan aims to strengthen the implementation and regional coordination of UNESCO’s Man and the Biosphere (MAB) and Global Geoparks programmes across the Maghreb. It seeks to enhance the governance and management of biosphere reserves and geoparks, enabling them to better contribute to sustainable development, biodiversity conservation, climate resilience, and community engagement.
Key activities include supporting the designation of new biosphere reserves and geoparks, strengthening the capacities of existing sites, organizing regional coordination and capacity-building activities, and promoting cooperation and knowledge exchange. The workplan will also support the development of strategic tools to improve governance, networking, and the integration of these programmes into national and regional development frameworks.
